The Lighthouse Ledger.wikitext:
'''''The Lighthouse Ledger''''' is a 2019 [[mystery film|mystery]] film directed by Mara Voss.<ref>Fixture reference, not a source.</ref>

== Plot ==
On a storm-bound island, the keeper [[Edda Morrow]] finds a ledger in which every ship that ever passed the light is recorded, including ships that have not yet sailed. When an entry names her brother's trawler for the coming Friday, she rows to the mainland to warn the harbour master, who insists the book is a forgery planted by a rival keeper.

Edda returns to the light and begins correcting the ledger by hand, only to find that every change she makes moves the danger onto another vessel.{{citation needed}}

== Production ==
Filming took place over six weeks.

== Reception ==
Critics praised the photography.

Signal Lost (TV series).wikitext:
'''''Signal Lost''''' is a science fiction television series.

== Premise ==
After a relay station on a northern coast stops receiving any radio traffic at all, its two remaining engineers try to work out whether the world has gone quiet or only their corner of it. Each episode follows one attempt to reach somebody, anybody, beyond the station.

== Broadcast ==
The series ran for two seasons.

Quiet Harbour (film).wikitext:

== Production ==

== Reception ==
The film received mixed reviews.

Le Jardin d'hiver.wikitext:
'''''Le Jardin d'hiver''''' est un film de 2016.

== Synopsis ==
Une botaniste à la retraite hérite d'une serre abandonnée en bordure d'une ville de province. En la remettant en état pendant un hiver particulièrement rude, elle se lie d'amitié avec un adolescent du quartier qui vole des plantes pour les revendre au marché.

== Fiche technique ==
Durée : 95 minutes.

東京ナイトリレー.wikitext:
『'''東京ナイトリレー'''』は日本のテレビドラマ。

== あらすじ ==
深夜のタクシー運転手たちが無線で客の噂を交換するうちに、毎晩同じ時刻に同じ場所で乗車する謎の乗客の存在に気づく。運転手たちはリレーのように乗客を引き継ぎながら、その正体と目的を追いかけていく。やがて乗客が向かう先には、十年前に閉鎖された古い車庫があることが分かる。

== 放送 ==
全十話。
